notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is now available!
In this update, we have added new items and weapons. And also fixed a number of detected bugs and made minor changes to the balance.
Have a nice game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi!

We have just released update 1.0.4.
This is a small update aimed at fixing bugs and improving balance.
In addition, brightness adjustment has been added to the options menu.

notes.title: Game Release!
Release date and price increase information.
notes.notes:
Hi!

Some news about the release date of One More Dungeon 2.
The game will leave Early Access on [b]September 19th[/b].
We also plan to raise the price of the game a [b]week after leaving early access[/b].
In the meantime, you can check out the new trailer :)

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] The third area of the dungeon, with a new environment, traps, enemies and a Boss.

[*] New negative effect - Burning.
[*] Dark Idols are objects that appear on levels and apply a negative effect until they are destroyed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39250027/399fcd62712b89c5db9e96fa10a719c500a1471e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi!

First of all, I would like to thank you for your feedback and wishes, they help us a lot!

And now a few words about how we plan to develop the game.

We want to release two major updates and then start developing the final version of the game. Each of these add-ons should take approximately three months to develop. They will contain new areas of the dungeon, expansions for the hub location, improvements to existing content, and of course new weapons and items.

Between these updates, we plan to release patches with bug fixes, by the way, the first of them (v0.2.2) is already available for download.

Thanks again for your support, hopefully soon we will be able to show you new materials on the game!
